claim: § The Taxonomy: one second-order equation covers the plucked string, the resonant filter and the transient — ζ alone moves it from ringing through critical to sluggish; driven at ω_n it swings Q times as far.

pieces.what: One mass-spring-damper with a ζ slider, drawn and heard: a pluck that rings, then clicks clean at ζ=1, then goes dull — the same curve as filter resonance and envelope
Drive the same system with a swept sine and plot amplitude and phase lag; the peak flattens past ζ≈0.7
The same system solved as a difference equation at a coarse step; push the step and it blows up — the discrete-vs-continuous question made audible
pieces.walks_up_from: the ζ slider at a fine step
